scope: Current public MaltaPost finder application/API, current website rights text and current Office of the Address Registrar locality/street context were audited without authenticating, accepting terms, contacting a provider, paying, requesting protected address/building/cadastral/land data or creating a publication destination.

countryIdentity.rule: Malta retains ISO MT and its Maltese archipelago scope. MaltaPost postcode assignment, OAR address/location identity, Planning Authority buildings, statistical/administrative geography and AGID containment remain separate evidence authorities.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete rights-cleared MaltaPost AAA NNNN postcode assignment and exception denominator, including ordinary address ranges and delivery groups, P.O. boxes, poste restante, organizations, facilities, special routing, non-geographic endpoints and historical or transition classes, and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, dataset-specific terms, byte length, SHA-256, coverage and exceptions, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real MT API/app so a normalized AAA NNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. Finder address responses, postcode prefixes, OAR localities or streets, address points, Planning Authority buildings, statistical/admin/cadastral units, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves. A derived surface is eligible only from an expressly authorized complete current postcode-membership denominator with reproducible lineage, limitations and noncanonical status preserved.

officialObservations.finding: The deployed finder bundle sets API version v1 and maxResult 50 and exposes town, street, address and search endpoints. Current anonymous GETs returned 89 towns, 116 Il-Ħamrun streets and three assignment rows for the operator's published HMR 2042 example. The response fields identify address components and postCode only; no geometry field, Polygon, MultiPolygon, coordinate or complete allocation denominator was exposed.

MaltaPost states that the current postcode was introduced in 2007, contains three letters followed by four digits and is found from street, locality and household number. This is format and individual assignment evidence, not a boundary release.

The website terms state that MaltaPost materials are copyrighted and allow unaltered reproduction only for personal, non-commercial use or internal circulation. No dataset-specific AGID bulk-processing, derivation, public-serving or redistribution grant was established.
The current service terms and privacy page were pinned as evidence context. They do not publish a postcode-boundary dataset or establish the missing data-specific public redistribution permission.
The current official table has one header row and 85 data rows with Locality Name, Local Council, Region Name MT and Region Name EN. It contains zero postcode tokens and zero geometry fields.
OAR exposes official street names and region, locality and local-council context. It is a location-register service, not MaltaPost postcode membership or postcode-area geometry.
All three anonymous requests returned HTTP 403 during this run. This is availability evidence only and does not prove that no dataset exists.

reproducibility.method: Byte/SHA-256 bind the twelve current bodies; inspect the deployed API base/version/maxResult and six endpoint names; parse current town, Il-Ħamrun street and published-example search arrays; parse the OAR four-column locality table; count geometry/postcode tokens; and keep raw page/API bodies out of Git.

dataQuality.risk: The current finder/API proves individual address-to-postcode assignment only. It has no area geometry or complete ordinary-plus-exception denominator, OAR context is non-postal, and website terms do not establish AGID public-serving rights.

browserReview.reason: No official or rights-cleared derived real MT postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists to exercise. Browser rendering was not staged with address rows, OAR locality/street context, buildings or synthetic proxy data.

reportPresentation.reason: An exact audit table communicates the zero-area, rights and denominator result more accurately than a chart.

blockerSummary: The current official finder/API returned current town, street and HMR 2042 address-assignment records, but its contract and responses contain no postcode-area geometry and do not establish a complete ordinary-plus-exception denominator. OAR localities/streets are separate non-postal context. MaltaPost website terms restrict reproduction and no dataset-specific AGID processing, derivation, public-serving or redistribution grant was established. A real MT area artifact cannot be served or rendered without unauthorized use or invented geometry.
unblockConditions: Obtain an unrestricted current authoritative MaltaPost postcode-boundary release, or an expressly authorized complete current postcode-membership denominator covering ordinary address ranges/delivery groups and every PO box, poste restante, organization, facility, special, non-geographic and historical/transition class with an approved reproducible derivation basis.
Pin edition or retrieval basis, effective date, dataset-specific terms, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, coverage, exceptions and accuracy limitations.

Validate Polygon/MultiPolygon closure, coordinate range, topology, Maltese territory scope, completeness and non-areal exceptions without substituting finder rows, postcode prefixes, OAR localities/streets, address points, buildings, administration/statistics/cadastre, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells or synthetic fixtures.
Publish an approved immutable artifact and pass real MT normalization, loader, API, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
